P.name: Umbra Blades
P.title: Template:Data Nocturne/Umbra Blades
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Umbra Blades|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Nocturne
|skill        = I
|icon         = Umbra Blades.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Nocturne}} next basic attack causes him to slash in a circle that deals {{as|'''increased''' physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies, {{tip|heal|healing}} him for each enemy hit.
|blurb2      = Basic attacks {{sti|cdr|reduce}} ''Umbra Blade's'' cooldown, increased against {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|champions}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Nocturne''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to slash in a circle, dealing {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies and {{tip|healing}} himself for {{pp|13 + (30-13)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} per enemy hit. Against {{tip|minions}}, ''Umbra Blades' '' damage to secondary targets and healing are reduced by 50% and it applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to all targets{{bug|2}} at 100% effectiveness.
|description2 = ''Umbra Blades'' can {{tip|critically strike}} against the primary target, modifying the {{as|physical damage}} dealt to{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nocturne|crit_base}}|100|mod=1.1}} AD.|AD}}|{{as|110% AD}}{{times}}{{sti|{{as|'''total''' critical damage}}}}.}}
|icon3        = Umbra Blades 2.png
|description3 = Basic attacks reduce ''Umbra Blades' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 3 against enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
|static       = 12
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 360
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = False
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* The primary target of the enhanced attack is dealt {{tip|basic damage}} while the secondary targets of the slash are dealt {{tip|proc damage}}.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
** Basic attacks against them will still grant the cooldown reduction.
* Parry effects will only block the damage dealt to the primary target.
}}

E.name: Unspeakable Horror
E.title: Template:Data Nocturne/Unspeakable Horror
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Unspeakable Horror|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Nocturne
|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Nocturne}} gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving towards {{tip|fear|feared}} targets.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' torments the target, forming a {{tip|tether}} that continually deals {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb3      = If the tether is not broken after a short time, the target is briefly {{tip|fear|feared}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Nocturne''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|90% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby {{tip|fear|feared}} targets.
|icon2        =  Unspeakable Horror.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nocturne''' torments the target, forming a {{tip|tether}} between himself and the target for 2 seconds, during which the target takes {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over the duration.
|leveling2    = {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|80/4 to 260/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100/4}}% AP)}}}}
|description3 = If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is {{tip|fear|feared}} for a duration while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 90%.
|leveling3    = {{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 2.25}} seconds}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1000|Fear MS radius}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 425
|tether radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 465
|cooldown     = {{ap|15 to 11}}
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 80}}
|costtype     = mana
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = special
|projectile   = False
|callforhelp  = True
|notes        = 
* ''Unspeakable Horror'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* Feared enemies in a {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 180° total angle within '''Nocturne's''' facing direction will trigger ''Unspeakable Horror's'' passive.
* Casting ''Unspeakable Horror'' may grant '''Nocturne''' permanent {{tip|ghosting}} until he has [[death|died]].{{bug}}
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application but not the damage and aftereffects of one already applied.
}}
